_about: Acetaldehyde (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetaldehyde, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetaldehyde, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: H. Sun, C. Liu, Z. Geng, Y. Lu, Y. Chen, Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Three Binary Systems of Acetaldehyde + Ethanol, Ethyl Acetate, 1-Butanol at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 2136-2142
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0061. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.38 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
